businessContext:
What this type of business does and what it sells/offers: A business is an organization or enterprising entity engaged in commercial, industrial, or professional activities. Its primary purpose is to provide goods or services to customers. The specific offerings vary immensely, ranging from tangible products like manufactured items or retail goods to intangible services such as consulting, software, or healthcare. At its core, a business identifies a market need and seeks to fulfill it through its operations.

What sector/industry it belongs to: The term 'business' is a universal category encompassing all sectors and industries. It is not an industry itself but the overarching framework for economic activity. Businesses are classified into sectors (e.g., primary, secondary, tertiary, quaternary) and specific industries like technology, finance, retail, manufacturing, or hospitality.

How it typically makes money (revenue model): A business generates revenue through the sale of its goods or services. Common revenue models include direct sales (one-time transactions), subscription fees (recurring access), licensing, advertising, commissions, leasing/renting, and franchising. The chosen model depends on the nature of the offering and the target market.

Who the typical customers are: Customers can be other businesses (B2B), individual consumers (B2C), governmental bodies (B2G), or a combination. The customer base is defined by the business's specific market positioning. For example, a software company might sell to enterprises (B2B) and also offer a consumer version (B2C).

What customers usually expect from this type of business: Customers universally expect value, which manifests as quality products or services, fair pricing, reliability, and good customer service. They also expect businesses to operate ethically, honor commitments, and provide clear communication. The exact expectations are shaped by the industry and the specific value proposition.

How competitive this industry typically is: Competition is a fundamental characteristic of business. The intensity varies by sector, market saturation, barriers to entry, and the rate of innovation. Some industries (like restaurants or retail) are highly competitive with many players, while others (like utilities or aerospace) may have high barriers leading to less direct competition but intense rivalry among few major firms.

Why having an online presence matters specifically for this category: In the modern economy, an online presence is critical for virtually every business. It serves as a primary channel for marketing, sales, customer engagement, and brand building. It allows for reach beyond local geography, provides social proof through reviews, enables data collection and personalization, and is often the first point of contact for potential customers. For many businesses, their website and social media profiles are as essential as a physical location.

== EXISTING WEBSITE ANALYSIS ==
## Site-Wide Structure
**Navigation Bar:** Persistent across all pages. Contains a top bar with email (Cilliescakes@gmail.com) and a main menu with links: Home, About, Cake flavors & Prices, Wedding Cakes, Tiered Birthday Kids Cakes, Sports, Birthday Cakes, Birthday Cakes 2, Baby Shower, Milestone Birthdays, Graduation, Party Platters. The navigation is extensive but somewhat disorganized with redundant links (e.g., multiple Birthday Cakes pages).
**Footer:** No distinct footer. Contact information and navigation links are repeated in the main content area of every page.
**Pages Found:** 10 pages crawled: Home, About, Cake flavors & Prices, Wedding Cakes, Tiered Cakes, Sports, Birthday Cakes, Birthday Cakes 2, Baby Shower, Milestone Birthdays. Pages for 'Graduation' and 'Party Platters' are linked in the nav but not crawled.

## Homepage (Page 1)
**Headings:** Ph: 281-530 1666 / Email: Cilliescakes@gmail.com / Facebook Group: Cillies Cakes of Houston / Our Shop Location / Get In Touch!
**Content:** Primarily a duplicate of the navigation and contact details. Lacks a clear hero section, value proposition, or introduction to the business. 'Our Shop Location' heading has no accompanying address or map.
**Media:** 2 images.
**Calls-to-Action:** Weak. Only 'Get In Touch!' headings with no associated form or clear instruction.

## About Page (Page 2)
**Headings:** Ph: 281-530 1666 / Email: Cilliescakes@gmail.com / Facebook Group: Cillies Cakes of Houston / Our Story / Get In Touch!
**Content:** 'Our Story' heading is present, but no descriptive text about the baker, business history, or philosophy is provided in the crawled data. Page is otherwise a template copy of contact info and nav.
**Media:** 3 images.

## Cake Flavors & Prices Page (Page 3)
**Headings:** Lists specific cake flavors: Tropical Paradise, Hersheys Vanilla Chocolate, I love Chocolate, Chocolate Cream. Also includes 'Have A Special Request?' and 'Get In Touch!'.
**Content:** Flavor names are listed, but no accompanying descriptions, ingredient details, portion sizes, or prices are visible in the crawled data.
**Media:** 6 images.

## Gallery/Portfolio Pages (Pages 4-10)
These include Wedding Cakes, Tiered Cakes, Sports, Birthday Cakes, Birthday Cakes 2, Baby Shower, Milestone Birthdays.
**Structure:** Each page is primarily a gallery of relevant cake images. Some pages (Birthday Cakes 2, Baby Shower) include a text note requesting a 2-week minimum for orders. The 'Birthday Cakes 2' page has some minimal pricing info (e.g., '# 2 $165 + tax').
**Content:** Heavy on images (ranging from 5 to 72 per page) but extremely light on textual information. No product descriptions, standard pricing, serving sizes, ordering process, or customization options are detailed.
**Calls-to-Action:** Repeated 'Get In Touch!' headings with no mechanism to do so beyond copying the email/phone.

## Contact Details
**Present on Every Page:** Phone number (281-530 1666) and email (Cilliescakes@gmail.com) are prominently displayed. A Facebook Group link is also listed.
**Missing:** Physical business address, operating hours, contact form, links to active social media profiles (only a Facebook Group is mentioned), online ordering or inquiry system.

## Testimonials
None found on any crawled page.

## Calls-to-Action
Very weak. The site relies entirely on passive contact information (phone/email). There are no buttons, forms, or compelling prompts to encourage inquiries or orders.

## Media
**Images:** The site's greatest strength is its extensive gallery of cake photos across numerous categories, showcasing the baker's work. However, images lack captions, descriptions, or context.
**Videos:** None detected.

## Overall Organisation
The site is poorly organized. It functions more as a basic image gallery than a functional business website. Critical information (prices, ordering details, business story, address) is missing or buried. Navigation is cluttered with similarly named pages. There is no clear hierarchy, consistent page layout, or professional content structure. The design appears to be a very basic template with repetitive content blocks.

== IMPROVEMENT OPPORTUNITIES (address these in the new site) ==
  - Add a clear, written 'Our Story' section on the About page detailing the baker's experience and passion.
  - Create a dedicated 'Contact Us' page with a contact form, full physical address with map, detailed operating hours, and all contact methods.
  - Completely restructure the 'Cake flavors & Prices' page to list each flavor with a description, available sizes, and clear prices.
  - Add a consistent, prominent call-to-action (e.g., 'Get a Quote', 'Order Now') on every page, linking to a contact form or the contact page.
  - Consolidate the 'Birthday Cakes', 'Birthday Cakes 2', and 'Tiered Birthday Kids Cakes' pages into a single, well-organized 'Birthday Cakes' gallery with categories.
  - Add captions or brief descriptions to gallery images (e.g., 'Two-tier vanilla cake with buttercream flowers').
  - Create a proper website footer containing contact info, simplified navigation, and social media icons (for actual profiles, not just a group).
  - Add an 'Ordering Process' or 'FAQ' page explaining how to place an order, lead times, payment methods, and delivery/pickup options.
  - Incorporate customer testimonials/reviews on the homepage and relevant gallery pages to build trust.
  - Ensure the 'Graduation' and 'Party Platters' pages (linked in the nav) are created and populated with content.
  - Improve the homepage with a welcoming hero image, a strong tagline, and summaries linking to key services.
  - Implement basic SEO improvements: fix page titles (some are just 'About'), add meta descriptions, and use alt text for all images.

- Modern, professional look appropriate for the business category
- Sections: Hero, About, Services, Testimonials (if reviews available), Contact
- Include the business phone number and address prominently
- Add a clear call-to-action (e.g. "Call Now", "Book Appointment", "Get a Quote")
- Use a colour palette that fits the business type
- Smooth scroll navigation
